Only 22% of remote job listings disclose pay. Here's what two brand designer roles actually pay in 2026.

On Loker Dollar, among 3,940 active remote listings, just 853 (22%) show a salary or rate. Two brand design roles that do:

- Stevens: Brand Identity Designer, $3,000–$5,000 per fixed project
- Sidekicks Creative Studio: Brand Identity Designer, $1,500–$3,000 per fixed project

Other design roles: WTP Global video edits $800–$1,200, Love Isn't Blind video editor $1,000–$2,000/month, South Digital ops lead $2,000–$4,000/month.

64% of listings accept worldwide remote applicants. The low pay visibility means many firms prefer private negotiations. For freelancers, focusing on the minority that publish rates gives a clearer benchmark.

Contrarian take: chasing the top-end $3,000–$5,000 fixed contracts can lock you into short, high-pressure sprints, while a modest $1,500–$3,000 retainer may provide steadier cash flow and room for upselling.

See the full analysis: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/remote-brand-designer-salary-trends-2026
